Replays: official HKJC replay-full broadcast angle only; no head-on or patrol footage. 720p re-encodes of the official files were used for R3, R4, R10 and R11; the original files for the rest. R10 had to be re-reviewed because the first video review did not receive the file.

AWT races R3 and R10 (WET SLOW): heavy kickback hid mid-pack and rear runners. In R3 none of the 500m/350m incidents (Superb Guy, Happydearhappydeer, Quick Money, Viva Taste) could be confirmed on video; they are recorded from the stewards report only. R10 Another Zonda's saddle slip and Loch Tay hanging in are likewise not confirmable on video.

Incidents not confirmable on video, recorded from the stewards report only: R1 severity of the Rock Your Dream check near 900m; R2 crowding near 1300m (My Flying Angel, The All Rounder) and Special Hedge near 1100m and 300m; R4 Happy Tercentenary/Storm Runner contact near 1100m; R7 Son Pak Fu/Blazing Wind near 1100m and Self Improvement eased near 1000m; R8 Vigor Fly crowded at the start; R9 Gulu Gogo held up 400m-250m; R11 King Equine's dropped rein.

Conflict: in R8 the stewards say MABUBU raced wide without cover for the majority of the event, but on the replay it was wide early before crossing to lead (official running positions 1-1-2). The row keeps the official wide_no_cover flag and notes the conflict.

Leader identity in R11: the video review placed SKY HEART in front early, while official running positions have GALLANT DREAM 1-1-2 and SKY HEART 2-2-1. The notes use only the official positions for both.

Replay-only flags (not in the stewards report): R1 Secret Hedge strong_closer; R3 Hailtothevictors strong_closer; R5 Legend Red Hare slow_away; R5 Yee Cheong Bright faded_after_leading; R8 Break Heaven strong_closer; R9 Not Usual Double wide_no_cover and strong_closer; R10 King Dance, Supreme Agility strong_closer; R11 Jolly Brilliant strong_closer/more_in_hand; R11 Gallant Dream and Sky Heart faded_after_leading.

Going changed during the meeting: turf GOOD TO YIELDING for R1-R2, R4-R5 and R7, and GOOD for R8, R9 and R11 (the stewards made the change retrospective from R8). The AWT was WET SLOW for R3 and R10. Races 5 and 8-10 were each put back 5 minutes.

Timing: HKJC published no official finish clock time. R11 was advertised for 18:15 HKT and its results were already posted at 18:48 HKT. The review started at 20:20 HKT, at least 2h after the advertised R11 time, with all 10 run races' official results and the full stewards report published (no interim or adjourned language visible).

Withdrawn horses (stewards-only rows, so no draw, odds, running positions or sectional exist): R3 VIEW OF COSMOS (at the barriers) and HAPPY ACTION (on 13.11.26), and R7 LUCKY WITH YOU (at the start).

Vet findings are copied verbatim from the official stewards report: roarer (previously reported) for R2 JUST FOLLOW ME and R3 VIGOR ELLEEGANT; epiglottic entrapment for R7 ON THE WAY; an abnormal respiratory noise reported by the rider of R8 FOREST KING, whose vet inspection showed no significant findings. No diagnosis is inferred from the video.
